subject: Startups
title: Month-over-Month Growth Rate
description: Learn Month-over-Month Growth Rate in one minute.

hook.text: Paul Graham says a good startup grows 5–7% per week. That compounds to 12–25x growth in one year.

buildup.text: MoM growth rate measures how fast key metrics increase each month: revenue, users, or transactions.

discovery.text: Consistent 15% MoM growth turns $10K MRR into $54K in one year. Compounding is shockingly powerful.

twist.text: Growth rate naturally declines as the base grows. Going from $100 to $115 is easy. $10M to $11.5M is not.

climax.text: Early-stage investors look at growth rate first. A small company growing fast beats a large company growing slowly.

punchline.text: Small numbers growing fast become big numbers. That's the bet.

quiz.question: Why does growth rate matter more than absolute size for early startups?
options: Small companies growing fast can outpace large slow ones
